endings.label: Spending the Rest of Life: Little Sister
endings.description:
Old friend:
The war is over, the smoke has long since cleared. Only now do I dare to write to you. In the end, I chose not to go further; at the moment when all were rushing toward the finale, toward glory and sacrifice, I stopped.
Is this cowardice? I became a deserter on a greater path. Though I have regained the power to grasp my own life, the war has left its marks on me – countless wounds. I often cannot tell which are from the wind and snow by the Volga, and which are the chill permanently lodged in my bones. I think the self I left on the battlefield will forever resent me until I truly die.
But I say, I am willing to stop all killing for one being. I do not regret this hesitation, because she bears no resentment toward me, and the door she has opened for me is far greater than any door in the Mansus. Someone once said: scars are doors of pain and possibility – she led me through them. Perhaps one day, everyone will pass through them under the gaze of Janus, just as we did. It is said that the Twins have not yet been struck from the rolls after the war – that is good. It suggests that love may indeed overcome pain, and even overcome the strife of the Horns.
See? She is calling me. I must stop writing.
Yours,
— Letter to the 'Exile', Crimea, 1945

endings.label: The Inevitable Path
endings.description:
Passing through the Stag Door, all that was mortal is extinguished. The Colonel names me in the smoke of war. Henceforth I am a piece on his unfolded battle map; in the assaults that no staff officer can explain, there lies the trace of my existence. The other Named Ones gather round and salute me in silence. We each fulfill our roles, taking ever more resolute strides toward our common goal.
I have discovered another grid on the battle map – that is the domain of another god, and the path to the door of victory lies within it. Among the scale-like color patches that all my marching arrows toward victory must rely on, I see her figure. My beloved. So her undulations aid my advance, and my victory becomes her extension.
I am war. She is the road. War is never achieved by one person alone, and a road is never trod by one alone.

[Congratulations on achieving one of the great victory endings. Even a minor victory might be achieved by only one in twenty players – and those who ascend this far are even fewer. We, and Janus, salute you.]

endings.label: Two-legged Worm
endings.description: Now, at last, I realize I know nothing of the Mansus. I am certain I am disconnected from reality; I am now at the center of a great sea, though I have never seen the sea in my life. “Mother Mokosh, I have lost my way, the path ahead is hidden. Show me the trail, lest I perish in this wilderness.” (Мати Мокошь, аз неведєнь, путь сокрытъ. Укажи ми стєзю, да не погинє во пустыни.)
